<tr><td><b>come to ˈlife</b></td><td>活跃起来；变得有生气</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The match finally came to life in the final minutes of the second half.<br>比赛在下半场的最后几分钟终于精彩起来。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>frighten/scare the ˈlife out of sb</b></td><td>把某人吓得魂飞魄散</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Don't do that! You scared the life out of me creeping up on me like that!<br>不要那样!你那样悄悄靠近我真是吓死我了!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get a ˈlife (spoken)</b></td><td>别这么无聊；找点正事做</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Simon, all you do is sit at home all day playing video games! Get a life!<br>西蒙，你怎么整天坐在家里玩电子游戏!别那么无聊好不好!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lead/live the life of Reilly/ˈRiley (informal)</b></td><td>过舒适无忧的生活</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>He inany herited a lot of money and since then he's been living the life of Riley.<br>他继承了一大笔钱，从此过着无忧无虑的生活。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>life after ˈdeath</b></td><td>死后的生命；来世</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Do you believe in life after death?<br>你相信死后再生吗？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(a matter of) ˌlife and/or ˈdeath (informal)</b></td><td>性命攸关（的事）</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>We need that business deal, it's a matter of life or death to the company.<br>我们需要做成那笔生意，这是有关公司存亡的大事。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the life and ˌsoul of the ˈparty (BrE)</b></td><td>全场最活跃的人；气氛担当</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>People always expect Jane to be the life and soul of the party.<br>聚会时人们总是期待简成为灵魂人物。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>life is ˈcheap (disapproving)</b></td><td>人命不值钱</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>In those mines life was cheap and accidents were barely reported.<br>那些矿井里人命不值钱，出了事故都没人报道。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(have) a life of its ˈown</b></td><td>（某物）像有生命一般；自行发展</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>When he was painting, he said, the brush used to take on a life of its own and take him in directions he never intended to go.<br>他说，在画画时，画笔仿佛具有生命力，带领他到意想不到的去处。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lose your ˈlife</b></td><td>丧生；遇难</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Sixty people lost their lives in the air crash.<br>在这次空难中，有六十人丧生。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>loss of ˈlife</b></td><td>人员伤亡；丧生</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>Fortunately there was no loss of life in the warehouse fire.<br>幸运的是这场仓库火灾没有人员死亡。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make life ˈdifficult (for sb)</b></td><td>给某人找麻烦；使日子难过</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She does everything she can to make life difficult for him.<br>她想尽办法给他制造麻烦。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make sb's life a ˈmisery</b></td><td>折磨某人；使某人痛苦不堪</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Ever since he joined the company he's made my life a misery.<br>自从他来到公司，我的生活便变得苦不堪言。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˈman/ˈwoman in your life (informal)</b></td><td>你生命中的那个男人（或女人）</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>So, is he the man in your life now, or just a good friend?<br>怎么，他现在是你的那位了，还是只是好朋友？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>not for the ˈlife of me, etc.</b></td><td>无论如何也不能；怎么也想不起</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I can't for the life of me remember his first name.<br>我怎么也记不起他的名字了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>for the life of him</b></td><td>他无论如何也（不能）</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He couldn't for the life of him understand why she was so annoyed.<br>他无论如何也不明白她为什么这么生气。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>not on your ˈlife (spoken)</b></td><td>（断然拒绝）绝不；没门儿</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Go out and miss the football match on TV? Not on your life!<br>外出错过收看电视播放的足球比赛？绝对不行!。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>see ˈlife</b></td><td>见世面；经历世事</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>She's done many different jobs all over the world. She's seen life, that's for sure.<br>她在世界各地从事过许多不同的工作。不用说，她见多识广。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>such is ˈlife (informal)</b></td><td>（表示无奈）这就是生活</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He didn't get the prize he was hoping for. But such is life, I suppose.<br>他没有得到希望中的奖赏。但是我想，生活就是这样。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take sb's ˈlife (formal)</b></td><td>杀害某人；夺去某人性命</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>In my opinion, the state does not have the right to take a person's life.<br>依我之见，政府无权剥夺人的生命。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take your ˌlife in your ˈhands</b></td><td>冒生命危险；豁出性命</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You take your life in your hands if you let him drive.<br>你要是让他开车，就是在拿自己的生命开玩笑。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take your own ˈlife (formal)</b></td><td>自杀</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>His children died in a house fire and shortly afterwards he took his own life.<br>他的几个孩子死于一次家庭火灾，不久后他就自杀了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌthat's ˈlife (also ˌc'est la ˈvie from French)</b></td><td>（表示无奈）生活就是这样</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Some people are born intelligent and some people are not. That's life.<br>有些人天资聪颖，有些人却不是这样。 ◎</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>there's ˌlife in the old dog ˈyet (humorous)</b></td><td>人老心不老；老当益壮</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Grandad won the fun run again—there's life in the old dog yet.<br>爷爷又赢了趣味长跑，真是老当益壮。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>this is the ˈlife!</b></td><td>（表示满足）这才叫生活</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Sunshine, a swimming pool and cham. pagne. This is the life!<br>阳光、泳池和香槟，这才是生活!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>to the ˈlife</b></td><td>（描摹）逼真；活灵活现</td><td>★<br>★★</td><td>The old sailor in the painting is drawn to the life.<br>画里那位老水手画得活灵活现。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>what a ˈlife!</b></td><td>这日子真难熬；人生太苦了</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Three hours travelling to work in a crowded train every day. what a life!<br>每天挤三小时的火车去上班，这哪是人过的日子!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>where there's ˈlife (ˌthere's ˈhope) (saying)</b></td><td>留得青山在，不怕没柴烧</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The game isn't over yet — we could still win. Where there's life there's hope.<br>比赛尚未结束一 - 我们仍有获胜的机会。只要有 -线希望就绝不放弃。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the chance, etc. of a ˈlifetime</b></td><td>千载难逢的机会</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>This is your chance to win the trip of a lifetime!<br>这是你赢得旅游机会的大好时机!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(not) lift a ˈfinger (to do sth) (informal)</b></td><td>（不）出一点力；（不）帮一点忙</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He didn't lift a finger to help me when I was in trouble.<br>我倒霉时，他一点儿忙也不肯帮，连指头也不动一根。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>thumb/hitch a ˈlift</b></td><td>搭便车；伸手拦车</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>We tried to hitch a lift, but nobody stopped to pick us up.<br>我们试图搭便车，但是没人停下来载我们。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be in sb's ˈlight</b></td><td>挡住某人的光线</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Could you move, please? You're in my light.<br>请挪一下好吗？你挡住我的光了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be light on sth</b></td><td>缺少某物；某方面不足</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>We seem to be light on fuel.<br>我们好像燃料不够了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be/go out like a ˈlight (informal)</b></td><td>很快睡着；突然失去知觉</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She went out like a light after an exhausting day at work.<br>一天辛苦的工作之后，她筋疲力尽，倒头就睡着了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>bring sth to ˈlight</b></td><td>揭露；使真相大白</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The police investigation brought to light evidence of more than one crime.<br>警方的调查披露了不止一起罪行的证据。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>cast/shed/throw (new) ˈlight on sth</b></td><td>阐明；使人对…有新认识</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>This book sheds new light on the role of the CIA.<br>这本书使人们对中央情报局的角色有了进一步的了解。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>come to ˈlight</b></td><td>被发现；为人所知</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>It recently came to light that he'd been in trouble with the police before.<br>他曾犯过案的事情最近才被披露出来。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in a ˌgood, ˌbad, ˌfavourable, etc. ˈlight</b></td><td>从好（或坏）的角度看</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You must not view what happened in a negative light.<br>千万不要负面地看待所发生的事。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈlight of sth (BrE) (AmE in ˈlight of sth)</b></td><td>鉴于；考虑到</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>In the light of what you have just told me, I am prepared to increase your loan to E5 000.<br>考虑到你刚刚告诉我的情况，我准备把货给你的款项增加至5 000 英镑。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) light as ˈair/a ˈfeather</b></td><td>轻如鸿毛；非常轻</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I love this jacket — it's really warm but it's as light as a feather.<br>我喜欢这件夹克，因为它又暖又轻。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(see the) ˌlight at the end of the ˈtunnel</b></td><td>（看到）苦尽甘来的希望；曙光在望</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>After three years of building work we can finally see light at the end of the tunnel.<br>施工三年，我们总算看到曙光了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(the) light ˈdawned (on sb)</b></td><td>恍然大悟；豁然开朗</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>I pusgled over the problem for ages before the light suddenly dawned on me.<br>我对这个问题冥思苦想了很久才豁然开朗。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(see) the light of ˈday</b></td><td>问世；公之于众</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>It was then that the idea of a European parliament first saw the light of day.<br>组建一个欧洲议会的想法就是在那时首次公开的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the light of sb's ˈlife</b></td><td>某人的心肝宝贝</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Elizabeth was his only child, the light of his life.<br>伊丽莎白是他唯一的孩子，他的掌上明珠。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a light ˈtouch</b></td><td>灵活巧妙的处理方式</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>She handles this difficult subject with a light touch.<br>她处理起这种难题来得心应手。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈlight of sth</b></td><td>轻描淡写；不把…当回事</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>She was in great pain but she always made light of it.<br>她承受着极大的痛苦，但很少把它放在心上。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make light ˈwork of sth (informal)</b></td><td>轻而易举地完成；轻松取胜</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>She made light work of that translation.<br>她做起那项翻译来毫不费力。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>see the ˈlight</b></td><td>恍然大悟；醒悟过来</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I think he's finally seen the light and is going to retire while he's still able to enjoy himself.<br>我想他最终想明白了，打算趁着还能享受人生之乐时就退休。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>set ˈlight to sth (especially BrE)</b></td><td>点燃；使着火</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>A spark from the fire had set light to a rug.<br>从火炉进出的火星引燃了地毯。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>with a light ˈheart</b></td><td>心情轻松地；欣然</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>She left the doctor's with a light heart. There was nothing wrong with her after all.<br>她愉快地离开了诊所，她的身体一点儿问题都没有。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get off/be let off ˈlightly (informal)</b></td><td>从轻发落；免受重罚</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Only two years in prison for stealing all that money? 1 think he got off very lightly.<br>偷了那么多钱却只入狱两年？ 我认为对他的判罚太轻了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>at/with ˌlightning ˈspeed</b></td><td>以闪电般的速度；飞快地</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The lecturer talked at lightning speed.<br>演讲者语速飞快。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌlightning never strikes (in the same place) ˈtwice</b></td><td>同样的倒霉事不会重演</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>We were burgled last year, but lightning never strikes twice.<br>去年我们家被偷了，不过倒霉事不会连着来。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈtwice (saying)</b></td><td>倒霉事不会在同一处（或同一人身上）重演</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Relax—lightning never strikes in the same place twice.<br>放宽心吧，这种倒霉事不会再来一次。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the lights are ˈon but nobody's ˈhome</b></td><td>（形容人）呆头呆脑；心不在焉</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Don't try discussing anything intelligent with Alice. The lights are on but nobody's home, I'm afraid.<br>不要和艾丽斯讨论需要动脑筋的问题，那恐怕是瞎子点灯——白费蜡。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>and the ˈlike (informal)</b></td><td>诸如此类；等等</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Professional people include lawyers, doctors, architects and the like.<br>专业人员包括律师、医生、建筑师等等。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>anything/nothing/something like that how would ˈyou like it?</b></td><td>换了你会怎么想呢</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>How would you like it if someone read your messages?<br>要是有人翻你的短信，你会怎么想？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>I like your ˈnerve, ˈcheek, etc. • I like ˈthat!</b></td><td>亏你说得出口（或做得出来）</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>She crashed into my car and now she wants me to pay for hers to be repaired. Well I like her nerve!<br>她撞了我的车，现在还想让我替她付修车的费用。她还真说得出口!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>if you ˈlike (spoken)</b></td><td>如果你愿意；你要是想的话</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>We can eat at home instead, if you like.<br>你要是愿意，我们可以改在家里吃。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) like as ˈnot • like eˈnough • most/very ˈlike</b></td><td>很可能；多半</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>As like as not he's stuck in traffic again on the ring road.<br>他多半又堵在环路上了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈlike (informal)</b></td><td>很可能；大概</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>As like as not, he'll be late. He usually is.<br>他很可能会迟到， 他往往是这样。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>out of/in the ˈlimelight</b></td><td>（不）受公众关注；（不）引人注目</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I you are married to a Prime Minister, you are always in the limelight.<br>要是你嫁给某位首相，你就永远都是众人关注的焦点。 ②</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be the (absolute) ˈlimit (old-fashioned, spoken)</b></td><td>实在令人受不了</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>You're the limit, Michael. Tve been waiting for you for over two hours. Where on earth have you been?<br>迈克尔，你太讨厌了。我已经等了你两个多小时，你到底去哪儿了？。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>within ˈlimits</b></td><td>在一定程度上；有限度地</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You can decorate the room however you want, within limits.<br>房间随你怎么布置，但要有个限度。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>all along/down the ˈline • right down the ˈline</b></td><td>彻头彻尾；在每个环节</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The project was badly managed all down the line.<br>这个项目从头到尾管理得一塌糊涂。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈline (informal)</b></td><td>完全地；在每一点上</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Weve had problems with this software all along the line. It was a complete waste of money.<br>这个软件从头到尾一直都给我们带来很大麻烦，购买它纯粹是浪费钱。◎</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>bring sb/sth into ˈline (with sb/sth)</b></td><td>使与…一致；使符合</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>We're trying to bring our production methods more into line with our Japanese competitors.<br>我们正设法在生产方法上进一步与日本的竞争对手保持一致。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in line for sth</b></td><td>有望获得某物</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She's in line for promotion.<br>她有望得到提拔。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˌline of ˈduty</b></td><td>在执行公务时；在履行职责时</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>A police officer was injured in the line of duty yesterday.<br>昨天有一名警察在执行公务时受了伤。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(be) in/out of ˈline with sb/sth</b></td><td>与…一致（或不一致）</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>His account of the meeting is completely out of line with mine.<br>他对会议的说法跟我的完全不一致。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reˈsistance</b></td><td>（采取）最省事的办法</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>You'll never get anywhere in life if you always take the line of least resistance.<br>如果你总是投机取巧，这一辈子将一事无成。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>line your (own)/sb's ˈpocket(s) (informal)</b></td><td>中饱私囊；发不义之财</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He'd been lining his pockets for years before it was discovered.<br>他多年中饱私囊，终于东窗事发。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on the ˈline</b></td><td>（名誉、工作等）面临风险</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>His whole reputation is on the line with this one trial.<br>这一场官司关系到他的全部声誉。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>somewhere, etc. along/down the ˈline</b></td><td>在某个时刻；在某个环节</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Somewhere along the line the two files got mixed up.<br>不知在哪个环节，这两份档案弄混了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>tread/walk a fine/thin ˈline</b></td><td>在两难间小心行事；如履薄冰</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.<br>他是在幽默和粗鲁之间走钢丝。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the bottom line</b></td><td>关键之处；最终结果</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The bottom line is we can't afford another delay.<br>关键在于，我们再也拖不起了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on/along the lines of...</b></td><td>按…的方式；类似于…</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He said something along the lines of never wanting to see me again.<br>他说了句大概是再也不想见我之类的话。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lines (spoken)</b></td><td>按…的方式；大致如此</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>The new system will operate along the same lines as the old one.<br>新系统的运作方式将与老系统一样。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌlingua ˈfranca (from Italian)</b></td><td>（不同母语者共用的）通用语</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>In the middle of the 20th century, English became the lingua franca of the world.<br>在20 世纪中期，英语已经成为全世界的通用语。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a link in the ˈchain</b></td><td>链条中的一环；过程中的一个环节</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Many people believe that coming from a broken home may be one of the first links in the chain that eventually leads to a life of crime.<br>很多人相信家庭破裂是使人走上犯罪之路的最初诱因之一。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the lion's ˈden</b></td><td>龙潭虎穴；难以应付的场合</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Before each one of her press conferences, she felt as if she were going into the lion's den.<br>在每次记者招待会之前，她都觉得自己似乎要深入龙潭虎穴。 ②</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˈlion's share (of sth) (BrE)</b></td><td>最大的一份</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The lion's share of the awards have gone to American stars again.<br>大多奖项再次落入美因影星囊中。 ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lick/smack your ˈlips</b></td><td>舔嘴唇；急不可待</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>They were licking their lips at the thought of clinching the deal.<br>他们一想到马上要做成这笔交易就显得急不可待。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>my lips are ˈsealed (informal, humorous)</b></td><td>守口如瓶；绝不外传</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Tell me the gossip—my lips are sealed, I promise.<br>跟我说说八卦吧，我保证守口如瓶。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on everyone's ˈlips</b></td><td>人人都在谈论</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The question on everyone's lips at the moment is: will they get married or not?<br>目前大家都挂在嘴边的问题是:他们到底</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>listen with half an ˈear</b></td><td>心不在焉地听；半听不听</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He listened with half an ear while scrolling through his phone.<br>他一边刷手机，一边心不在焉地听着。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a little ˈbird told me (that...) (spoken)</b></td><td>有人私下告诉我；小道消息说</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>A little bird told me you might be applying first to have a state postal service. Well, you live for another job. Is that true?<br>我听说你可能正在</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌlittle by ˈlittle</b></td><td>一点一点地；逐渐地</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Little by little she taught herself to play the piano.<br>她一点一点自学会了弹钢琴。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈlittle of sth</b></td><td>不重视；轻描淡写</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>She made little of all the problems in the department they were living well beyond their means.<br>他们看</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>more than a little exˈcited, ˈshocked, etc.</b></td><td>非常兴奋（或震惊等）</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>Peter was more than a little disappointed not to be chosen for the team.<br>彼得因为没有被选进队里而非常失望。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>little ˈfinger (informal)</b></td><td>任意摆布某人；玩弄于股掌之间</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>That child can twist his grandmother round his little finger.<br>那孩子把奶奶哄得团团转。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live and ˈbreathe sth</b></td><td>全身心投入；痴迷于某事</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He lives and breathes football, even on his wedding day.<br>他痴迷足球，连结婚那天也不例外。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live and ˈlearn</b></td><td>活到老学到老；吃一堑长一智</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I'll never buy a used phone online again—live and learn.<br>我再也不网购二手手机了，吃一堑长一智。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live and ˈlet live (saying)</b></td><td>自己活也让别人活；彼此宽容</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>My neighbours and I live and let live, and we get along fine.<br>我和邻居互不干涉，相处得挺好。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live beyond/within your ˈmeans</b></td><td>入不敷出；量入为出</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>They lived beyond their means for years and ended up in debt.<br>他们多年入不敷出，最后欠了一身债。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live by/on your ˈwits</b></td><td>靠机智谋生；随机应变过活</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Patrick did not go to college, as expected, but learned to live very successfully on his wits.<br>不出所料，帕特里克果然没有去上大学，而是学会靠投机取巧赚大钱。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live (from) ˌhand to ˈmouth</b></td><td>勉强糊口；挣一天吃一天</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>They lived hand to mouth all winter until the work picked up.<br>整个冬天他们勉强糊口，直到活儿多起来。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live in ˈhope</b></td><td>怀着希望；一直盼着</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The situation doesn't look too good, but we live in hope.<br>情形看起来不太妙，但我们仍抱有希望。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live in ˈsin (old-fashioned or humorous)</b></td><td>未婚同居</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Are you two married yet or are you still living in sin?<br>你们两个结婚了吗，还是仍然在未婚同居？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live it ˈup (informal)</b></td><td>尽情享乐；纵情挥霍</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Since his retirement he has been living it up in the south of Spain.<br>自从退休之后，他一直在西班牙南部尽情享乐。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live like a ˈking</b></td><td>过帝王般的生活；生活阔绰</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>In thus luury resort, you can live like a king.<br>在这个奢华的度假胜地，你可以像国王一样生活。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live off/on the ˌfat of the ˈland (informal)</b></td><td>锦衣玉食；过奢侈生活</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Money was no problem then. We were living off the fat of the land in those days.<br>在那时候，钱根本不成问题，我们过着锦衣玉食的日子。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>live to fight another ˈday (saying)</b></td><td>留得青山在；改日再战</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>She only just lost the election, so she lives to fight another day.<br>她输掉了选举，但结果很接近，所以打算卷土重来。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>you haven't ˈlived</b></td><td>你算是白活了</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Youve never been to New York? You haven't lived!<br>你从未去过纽约？你真是白活了!</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>be ˌliving ˈproof of sth</b></td><td>是…的活证据</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He plays tennis and golf. He's living proof that a heart attack doesn't mean the end of an active life.<br>他又打网球又打高尔夫球。一次心脏病发作并不意味着无法过有活力的生活，他就是活生生的证据。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in/within ˌliving ˈmemory</b></td><td>在当今人们的记忆中</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>These are the worst floods in Britain within living memory.<br>这些是当今的人们记忆中英国境内最严重的洪水。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a living ˈlegend (also a ˌlegend in your own ˈlifetime)</b></td><td>在世的传奇人物</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Her 30-year study of chimpanzees made her a living legend.<br>对黑猩猩长达30年的研究使她成为当代的传奇人物。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>get a load of ˈthis (spoken)</b></td><td>瞧瞧这个；听听这个</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Get a load of this. They want to build a new road right across here.<br>听着，他们想修一条穿过这里的公路。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>lock ˈhorns (with sb) (over sth)</b></td><td>（与某人）争执；发生冲突</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The lawyers did not want to lock horns with the judge.<br>律师们不想和法官争论不休。 ②</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌlock, stock and ˈbarrel</b></td><td>全部；彻底地</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>They were all emigrating so they were selling everything they had, lock, stock and barrel.<br>他们都将移居外国，正在变卖所有的财产。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>in ˌloco paˈrentis (from Latin, formal)</b></td><td>代行父母之责</td><td>★<br>☆</td><td>Teachers at a boarding school are acting much more in loco parentis than at a day school.<br>寄宿学校的教师比全日制学校的教师更像孩子们的父母，所负责任也多得多。 ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>at ˈloggerheads (with sb) (over sth)</b></td><td>（与某人）不和；有严重分歧</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>The students are at loggerheads with the college over the price of food in the cafeteria.<br>学生们就食堂饭菜的价格问题和学校争执不休。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌlone ˈwolf</b></td><td>独来独往的人；独行侠</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>In the police force he had the reputation of being something of a lone wolf.<br>在警队中，他有独行侠的名声。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>as/so ˈlong as be in sth for the long ˈhaul</b></td><td>打持久战；愿意坚持到底</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>As long as you tidy your room first, you can go out to play.<br>只要你先整理好你的房间，就可以出去玩。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>for (so) ˈlong</b></td><td>（这么）长时间；长久地</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Will you be away for long?<br>你要离开很久吗？。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>go back a long ˈway</b></td><td>（人之间）相识很久</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>John and 180 back a long way, don't we?<br>我和约翰相识很久了，不是吗？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have come a long ˈway</b></td><td>取得很大进步；大有长进</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Cancer treatment has come a long way since my grandmother was first diagnosed.<br>自我祖母初次确诊以来，癌症治疗已有了长足进步。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>how long is a piece of ˈstring? (BrE, spoken)</b></td><td>说不准；这可没准数</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>You ask how much the repair will cost—well, how long is a piece of string?<br>你问修理要多少钱，这可真说不准。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈlong run</b></td><td>从长远来看；最终</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Buying your own house is a big expense at first but in the long run it's cheaper than paying rent.<br>买房虽然最初花费很高，但从长远来看，还是比租房划算。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>the long and (the) ˈshort of it</b></td><td>总而言之；总的情况就是这样</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The long and the short of it is that we can't afford the house.<br>总而言之，这房子我们买不起。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the long arm of the ˈlaw</b></td><td>法律的力量；法网恢恢</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>You have to be a very clever criminal to escape the long arm of the law.<br>再聪明的罪犯也</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(pull, wear, etc.) a long ˈface</b></td><td>闷闷不乐；哭丧着脸</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I asked him if he wanted to come out but he pulled a long face and said no.<br>我问他是否想出来，他哭丧着脸说不想。 ></td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a long ˈhaul (informal)</b></td><td>漫长而艰辛的事；长途跋涉</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>It was a long haul doing the degree part-time, but it was worth it.<br>在职攻读学位虽然费时很长且很辛苦，但是非常值得。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(be) ˌlong in the ˈtooth (humorous, especially BrE)</b></td><td>年事已高；上了年纪</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Pm a bit long in the tooth for all-night parties.<br>我年岁大了，不能参加这种通宵聚会。 ③</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈlong shot (informal)</b></td><td>成功机会不大的尝试；胜算很小的猜测</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Try ringing him at home. It's a long shot, 1 know, but he might just be there.<br>试试给他家打电话。我知道也许没用，但是也可能他就在家中。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>long time no ˈsee (spoken)</b></td><td>好久不见</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Well, hello! Long time no see.<br>哦，你好!好久不见。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>not by a ˈlong chalk (BrE) (also not by a ˈlong shot AmE, BrE) (informal)</b></td><td>差得远；绝不；一点也不</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The job isn't finished, not by a long chalk—we've barely started.<br>活儿还差得远呢，我们才刚开了个头。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>over the long ˈhaul</b></td><td>从长远看；在很长一段时间里</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Over the long haul, shares still remain the best form of investment.<br>就长远来看，股票仍然是最佳的投资方式。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>so ˈlong (for now) (informal)</b></td><td>再见；回头见</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>So long for now. Tll see you soon.<br>再会，我们很快会再见面的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take a long (cool/hard) ˈlook at sth</b></td><td>慎重考虑；深思熟虑</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>After taking a long hard look at the cost of employung an extra Person, we decided against it.<br>经过对成本的慎重考虑，我们决定不再另雇一名员工。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take the ˈlong view (of sth)</b></td><td>从长计议；着眼长远</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You always have to take the long view when you are thinking about spending money on education.<br>在考虑教育花费的问题时，你需要从长计议。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>to cut a long story ˈshort (BrE) (AmE to make a long story ˈshort) (spoken)</b></td><td>长话短说；简而言之</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>To cut a long story short, we missed the flight and drove instead.<br>长话短说，我们误了航班，改成开车了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>no/any ˈlonger</b></td><td>不再；已不</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I can't wait any longer.<br>我不能再等了。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>any ˈluck? (spoken)</b></td><td>有戏吗；运气如何</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Any luck with the job applications you sent out last week?<br>上周投的那些简历有消息了吗？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be down on your ˈluck (informal)</b></td><td>时运不济；穷困潦倒</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He employed a retired soldier who was down on his luck to tidy up the garden.<br>他雇了一个时运不济的退伍兵来清理花园。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>do sth for ˈluck</b></td><td>为求吉利而做某事</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Take something blue. It's for luck.<br>挑件蓝色的东西吧，求个吉利。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>good ˈluck (with sth) (spoken)</b></td><td>祝好运；祝成功</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Good luck with your exams.<br>祝你考试成功。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>good ˈluck to sb (spoken)</b></td><td>祝某人走运；随他去吧</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>If he wants to cycle across Mongolia, good luck to him.<br>他要骑车穿越蒙古，那就祝他好运吧。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>you're in ˈluck • your ˈluck is in</b></td><td>你走运了；运气来了</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>You're in luck—there's exactly one seat left on the evening train.<br>你走运了，晚班车刚好还剩一个座位。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the luck of the ˈdevil • the luck of the ˈIrish</b></td><td>运气好得出奇</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>You need the luck of Iull/AV the devil to get a seat on the train in the rush • storm the calm/lull betore the storm hour.<br>上下班交通高峰期，你得非常走运才能在火</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˌluck of the ˈdraw</b></td><td>全凭运气；碰运气的事</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Which examiner you get is just the luck of the draw.<br>碰上哪个考官，全凭运气。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>no such ˈluck (informal)</b></td><td>没那么走运；可惜没有</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>I hoped the meeting was cancelled, but no such luck.<br>我盼着会议取消，可惜没那么走运。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>tough/bad ˈluck (informal)</b></td><td>真不走运；活该（视语气而定）</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Tough luck about the concert tickets—they sold out in four minutes.<br>演唱会门票四分钟就没了，真不走运。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have a ˈlump in your throat</b></td><td>（激动得）喉咙哽住</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I had a lump in my throat watching my daughter walk onto the stage.<br>看着女儿走上台，我喉咙一阵发哽。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take your ˈlumps (AmE, informal)</b></td><td>承受打击；甘愿挨批</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>He made the mistake, so he'll have to take his lumps at the meeting.<br>错是他犯的，会上挨批他就得受着。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the lunatic ˈfringe (disapproving)</b></td><td>（团体中的）极端分子；狂热的少数人</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>Most members are reasonable; it's the lunatic fringe that gets on television.<br>多数成员都很理性，上电视的偏偏是那帮极端分子。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌout to ˈlunch (informal, especially AmE)</b></td><td>神志不清；糊里糊涂</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>She has talent physically but mentally she's out to lunch.<br>她有体育天分，但智力上有所欠缺。 ></td></tr>
<tr><td><b>leave sb in the ˈlurch (informal)</b></td><td>在危难时弃某人不顾</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You can't resign now and leave us all in the lurch. It wouldn't be fair.<br>你不能在这个时候辞职，抛下我们大家不管，这不仗义。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(not) take sth lying ˈdown (informal)</b></td><td>（不）甘心忍受；（不）逆来顺受</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I'm not going to take this stupid decision lying down. If necessary, rl take the company to court.<br>我不会乖乖地接受这个愚蠢的决定。如果有必要，我将起诉公司。</td></tr>
<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">M</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be mad ˈkeen (on sb/sth) (informal)</b></td><td>对…极其着迷</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She's been mad keen on African music ever since she came back from Zimbabwe last year.<br>自从去年从津巴布韦回来，她便对非洲音乐着了迷。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) mad as a ˈhatter</b></td><td>疯疯癫癫；十足的疯子</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The old man who feeds the crows is as mad as a hatter, but harmless.<br>那个喂乌鸦的老头疯疯癫癫，不过没有恶意。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) mad as a March ˈhare (informal)</b></td><td>疯疯癫癫；举止怪异</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>She danced through the office in slippers, mad as a March hare.<br>她穿着拖鞋在办公室里跳舞，简直疯疯癫癫。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be made ˈup (about/with sth) (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>对某事非常满意；乐坏了</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>I'm really made up with the new job. It's the type of work I've always wanted.<br>我对这份新工作真的很称心，这是我一直想要从事的工作。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have it ˈmade (informal)</b></td><td>稳操胜券；万事俱备</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>With a paid-off house and a pension like that, he's got it made.<br>房贷还清，还有那样的退休金，他这辈子不愁了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(be) ˈmade for sb/each other</b></td><td>非常般配；天生一对</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Jen and Alan seem made for each other, don't they?<br>珍和艾伦像是天生的一对， 是吧？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>what sb is ˈmade of (informal)</b></td><td>某人的真本事；某人有几分能耐</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Let's see what he's made of.<br>咱们来看看他到底有什么能耐。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(have) a/the magic ˈtouch</b></td><td>有过人的本领；有点石成金的本事</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She seems to have a magic touch with the children and they do everything she asks.<br>她和孩子们相处起来很有一套，孩子们都听她的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈmain</b></td><td>大体上；基本上</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>In the main, the students did well in the exam.<br>在这次考试中，学生们的表现基本上令人满意。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make as if to do sth (written)</b></td><td>做出要做某事的样子</td><td>★★<br>★</td><td>He made as if to leave, then sat back down and ordered another beer.<br>他做出要走的样子，又坐下再要了一杯啤酒。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈbreak for it (informal)</b></td><td>趁机逃跑；夺路而逃</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Six prisoners shot a guard and made a break for it in a stolen car.<br>六名囚犯开枪打死一名看守，驾着一辆偷来的车逃跑了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈdo (with sth) • make sth ˈdo</b></td><td>凑合；将就着用</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Ireally need a large frying pan but if you haven't got one rl have to make do with that small one.<br>我实际上需要一个大煎锅，但是如果你没有，我也只好凑合用那个小的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈgo of sth (informal)</b></td><td>把某事做成功</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Weve had quute a jew problems In our marrage but we're both determined to make a go of it.<br>我们的婚姻有过很多问题，但我们双方决心好好过</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈgood (informal)</b></td><td>发家致富；白手起家获得成功</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He's a local boy made good.<br>他是一个靠奋斗发家的本地青年。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make good sth</b></td><td>赔偿；修复；兑现（诺言）</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The suitcase went missing at the airport so the airline have agreed to make good the loss.<br>手提箱是在机场丟失的，所以航空公司已经同意赔偿损失。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mechanic explained that they would have to ˈmake it</b></td><td>成功；赶到；活下来</td><td>☆<br>★★</td><td>Two of the three startups failed, but hers actually made it.<br>三家创业公司倒了两家，她那家真做成了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈmake it with sb (AmE, slang)</b></td><td>与某人发生性关系</td><td>★<br>★★★★★</td><td>He makes like he's the greatest actor of all time.<br>他装模作样，仿佛自己是有史以来最棒的潢员。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make the ˈmost of sth</b></td><td>充分利用；尽情享受</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The meeting finished early so I decided to make the most of being in London and do some shopping.<br>会议结束得早，我决定充分利用在伦敦的这段时间购物。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make the ˈmost of yourself, himself, etc.</b></td><td>充分展示自己的长处</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She's a pretty girl but she doesn't make the most of herself.<br>她长得很漂亮，但是她并没有尽力打扮自己。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈmuch of sb/sth (written)</b></td><td>重视；大肆宣扬</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>The media made much of the fact that she was the first woman pilot to fly a jumbo jet.<br>她是首位驾驶大型喷气式客机的女飞行员，媒体大力宣传这一点。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make nothing ˈof sth</b></td><td>不理解；不把…当回事</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>What a hill! But even with her heavy bag, Amy made nothing of it and was movng at top speed.<br>多么陡峭的山啊!但埃米对此全然不在乎，背着笨重的包还能快速往上攀爬。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make or ˈbreak (informal)</b></td><td>成败攸关；决定成败</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>This movie is make or break for the production company.<br>这部影片是制片公司成败的关键。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈmake something of yourself</b></td><td>有所成就；事业有成</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She has the education, the talent and the brains to really make something of herself.<br>她受过良好的教育，又具备天资和才智，定能有所成就。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on the ˈmake (informal, disapproving)</b></td><td>一心谋私利；追名逐利</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Jack was a young man on the make. Not so much for fame, but for money.<br>杰克年纪轻轻就爱追逐名利；他追求更多的是利， 而不是名。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make ˈeyes at sb (informal)</b></td><td>向某人抛媚眼；暗送秋波</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He spent the whole party making eyes at the girl by the window.<br>整场派对他都在朝窗边那个女孩抛媚眼。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be the ˈmaking of sb/sth</b></td><td>是某人（或某事）成功的关键</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>It was only a small part in a TV show, but it was the making of her.<br>虽然这只是一个电视节目中的一个小角色，但却使她成了名。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈmaking</b></td><td>在形成中；在酝酿中</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Hess very good at public speaking1 think he's a politician in the making.<br>他擅长公众演讲，我认为他正在逐步成长为一个政治象。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>of your own ˈmaking</b></td><td>自己造成的；自作自受</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The problem is of your own making, so don't try to blame anyone else.<br>问题的责任在你自己，别想责怪他人。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have the ˈmakings of sth</b></td><td>具备成为…的条件</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She's got the makings of a good tennis player, but she needs to practise much harder.<br>她具备了优秀网球选手的素质，但需进一步刻苦训练。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>with ˌmalice aˈforethought (law)</b></td><td>蓄意；预谋</td><td>★<br>☆</td><td>Suddenly Guy, more by way of a nervous twitch than with malice aforethought, pulled the trigger.<br>盖伊突然扣动了扳机，但他并非有意开枪，只是因为太紧张，抽搐了一下。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be sb's ˈman/ˈwoman</b></td><td>是（做某事）最合适的人选</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>If you need someone to fix that old boiler, Tom's your man.<br>要修那台老锅炉，找汤姆准没错。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be ˈman enough (to do sth/for sth)</b></td><td>有足够的勇气（做某事）</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Be man enough to apologize to her in person, not by text.<br>拿出点担当，当面跟她道歉，别发短信。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be no good/use to ˈman or ˈbeast (informal)</b></td><td>毫无用处；一无是处</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Since the Chernobyl disaster the land round here has been no use to man or beast.<br>自从切尔诺贝利核泄漏事件发生后，周围的那片土地就变得毫无用处了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be your own ˈman/woman</b></td><td>独立自主；有主见</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Since going freelance she's finally her own woman again.<br>自从做了自由职业，她终于又能自己做主了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>every man has his ˈprice • everyone has</b></td><td>人皆有价；人人都可能被收买</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The lawyer smiled and said every man has his price, including judges.<br>律师笑着说人皆有价，法官也不例外。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>their ˈprice (saying)</b></td><td>人皆有价；重赏之下必有勇夫</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Offer enough and everyone has their price, or so the cynics claim.<br>出价够高，人人都有价，愤世嫉俗者如是说。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>it's every ˌman for himˈself (saying)</b></td><td>各人顾各人；人人自顾</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>In business, it's every man for himself.<br>生意场上都是人各为已。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈman of/out of sb</b></td><td>使某人成为男子汉；使人长大成人</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>My father was very old-fashioned. He was always trying to make a man of me' by taking me fishing or camping with him.<br>我父亲非常老派，他总是带我去钓鱼或露营，希望用这种方式使我“成为男于汉”。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a/the ˌman about ˈtown</b></td><td>交际场上的活跃人物；社交名流</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>In his thirties he was a man about town who knew every club owner.<br>三十多岁时他是个社交场上的活跃人物，认识每家夜店老板。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>man and ˈboy</b></td><td>从小到大；一辈子</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>He's been doing the same job for 50 years - man and boy.<br>他从小就干这工作，有50年了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˌman (and/or ˌwoman) in the ˈstreet</b></td><td>普通人；老百姓</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The man in the street cares about rent, not about party slogans.<br>老百姓关心的是房租，不是政党口号。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌClapham ˈomnibus (old-fashioned)</b></td><td>普通人；平民百姓</td><td>☆<br>★★</td><td>Would the man on the Clapham omnibus think this contract fair?<br>普通百姓会觉得这份合同公平吗？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌman of ˈGod/the ˈcloth (old-fashioned, formal)</b></td><td>神职人员；牧师</td><td>★<br>★★</td><td>As a man of the cloth, he was expected to visit the sick weekly.<br>身为神职人员，他每周都要去探望病人。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˌman of the ˈmatch (BrE, sport)</b></td><td>（比赛的）最佳球员</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The keeper saved two penalties and was named man of the match.<br>门将扑出两个点球，当选全场最佳。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌman of the ˈpeople</b></td><td>体察民情的人；平民出身的领袖</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The main reason he was so popular was that despite being one of the most powerful men in the country, he was also a man of the people.<br>他广受拥戴的主要原因是，尽管是国家的最高权力者之一，他仍然非常体恤民情。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌman of ˈstraw</b></td><td>懦夫；无足轻重的人</td><td>★<br>★★</td><td>The new chairman turned out to be a man of straw with no real authority.<br>新任主席原来是个没有实权的软弱角色。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>man to ˈman</b></td><td>（男人之间）坦诚地；开诚布公地</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I'm telling you all this man to man.<br>我要把这一切都坦率地告诉你。0</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>man's best ˈfriend</b></td><td>人类最好的朋友（指狗）</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>After the rescue, everyone agreed the dog was truly man's best friend.<br>救援之后，大家都说狗真是人类最好的朋友。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈman's man</b></td><td>更受男人欢迎的男人</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He's a man's man—football, beer and very little small talk.<br>他是那种典型的男人堆里的男人：足球、啤酒，很少闲聊。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>one man's ˌmeat is another man's ˈpoison (saying)</b></td><td>各人口味不同；甲之蜜糖，乙之砒霜</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>I'm amazed that Tim enjoys cricket so much. Still, one man's meat is another man's poison, as they say.<br>蒂姆如此热衷板球运动，真令我吃惊。 不过，常言说，萝卜青菜，各有所爱。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>to a ˈman (written)</b></td><td>一致地；无一例外</td><td>★<br>★</td><td>To a man, they all agreed.<br>他们全都赞成此事。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>you can't keep a good man ˈdown (saying)</b></td><td>有本事的人终会出头</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He failed his driving test twice, but passed on the third try — you can't keep a good man down!<br>他头两次驾驶考试都失败了，但第三次通过了。正所谓，有志者，事竟成!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>rent</b></td><td>租金；房租</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Half my salary goes on rent for a flat the size of a shoebox.<br>我半份工资都交了房租，房子却小得像鞋盒。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(be) off the ˈmap</b></td><td>偏僻；远离闹市</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>It's a little house in the country, a bit off the map.<br>这是一所乡下小房子，比较偏僻。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>put sb/sth on the ˈmap</b></td><td>使出名；使受到重视</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Her performance in her first film really put her on the map.<br>她在首部影片中的表现使她出了名。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lose your ˈmarbles (informal)</b></td><td>精神失常；发疯</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>They say the old man has lost his marbles because of the strange things he's been saying, but I'm not so sure.<br>他们说这个老人满嘴胡言乱语，准是疯了，可我不太相信。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>March</b></td><td>三月</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>We're moving house in March, right after the lease runs out.<br>我们三月搬家，正好租约到期。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>march to (the beat of) a different</b></td><td>特立独行；与众不同</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She's always marched to a different beat, wearing red boots to funerals.<br>她从来特立独行，参加葬礼都穿红靴子。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈdrummer/drum (also march to a different ˈtune less frequent)</b></td><td>与众不同；另有一套想法</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>She was a gifted and original artist who marched to a different drummer.<br>她是位既有天赋又有创意的艺术家，风格与众不同。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>marching</b></td><td>行进；行军</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The band kept marching down the street despite the pouring rain.<br>尽管大雨倾盆，乐队仍沿街行进。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get your ˈmarching orders (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>被解雇；被赶走</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>When he kept arriving late he got his marching orders.<br>他由于老迟到，被开除了。 ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>give sb their ˈmarching orders (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>解雇某人；命令某人走人</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>When she found out he was seeing another woman, she gave him his marching orders.<br>她发现他在和其他女人约会，便提出分手。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈmare's nest</b></td><td>看似重大实则无用的发现；混乱局面</td><td>★<br>★★</td><td>I fancy this will prove to be a mare's nest! We have had these mysteries before.<br>我认为这不会有什么价值，之前我们也遇到过这样的谜团。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be close to/near the ˈmark</b></td><td>接近准确；八九不离十</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The estimate of the total cost had been pretty close to the mark, in fact.<br>事实上，总成本的评估相当准确。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be ˌquick/ˌslow off the ˈmark</b></td><td>反应快（或慢）；行动敏捷（或迟缓）</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>You have to be quick off the mark when you answer a newspaper advertisement for an apartment.<br>一旦在报纸的广告栏里找到合适的公寓，就要尽快回复。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get off the ˈmark</b></td><td>开始得分；起步</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Stewart got off the mark with afour.<br>斯图尔特以一记四分球开始得分。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make your ˈmark</b></td><td>崭露头角；扬名</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He's an actor who has made his mark in comedy shows.<br>他是一个以演喜剧片出名的演员。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌmark my ˈwords (old-fashioned, spoken)</b></td><td>记住我的话；听我一句</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>He'll be back, mark n words!He never stays away for long.<br>听我说!他很快就会回来，他从不离开太久。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mark ˈtime</b></td><td>原地踏步；等待时机</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He's just marking time in that job until his visa comes through.<br>他在那份工作上原地踏步，就等签证下来。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mark ˈyou (old-fashioned, spoken, especially BrE)</b></td><td>请注意；不过话说回来</td><td>★<br>★★★★★</td><td>She hasn't had much success yet. Mark you, she tries hard.<br>她还没取得什么成功，可是她非常努力。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌup to the ˈmark</b></td><td>达到标准；合格</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>His English and history are very g00d, but his maths is not really up to the mark.<br>他的</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a marked ˈman</b></td><td>被盯上的人；成为攻击目标的人</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>When they discovered he was a spy, he became a marked man.<br>当他们识破他的间谍身份后，他的处境就变得十分危险了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈmarket for sth (informal)</b></td><td>有意购买；正想买</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I'm not in the market for a car as expensive as that.<br>我无意购买如此昂贵的汽车。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on the ˈmarket</b></td><td>上市；有售；待售</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>This computer isn't on the market yet. You should be able to buy one early next year.<br>这款计算机还未上市，明年初应该能买到。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>play the ˈmarket</b></td><td>做股票投机；炒股</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>He's been playing the market for 30 years, but is quick to warn people of the risks involved.<br>他炒股票 30 年了，不过还是一有机会就提醒人们注意其中的风险。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on your ˌmarks, get ˌset, ˈgo!</b></td><td>各就位，预备，跑！</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>The teacher shouted 'on your marks, get set, go!' and the children sprinted off.<br>老师喊“各就位，预备，跑！”，孩子们冲了出去。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>marry in ˈhaste (, repent at ˈleisure) (saying)</b></td><td>结婚匆忙，后悔漫长</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>They married after six weeks—marry in haste, repent at leisure, as they say.<br>他们认识六周就结婚，正应了那句：结婚太急，后悔莫及。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>marry ˈmoney</b></td><td>嫁（或娶）有钱人</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>His Sister married money — she lives in Bermuda now.<br>他妹妹嫁了个有钱人，现在住在百慕大群岛。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be a ˈmass of sth</b></td><td>布满；充满</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The garden was a mass of flowers.<br>花园里花团锦簇。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be your own ˈmaster/ˈmistress</b></td><td>自己作主；独立自主</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>There's no point trying to tell him what to do. He's his own master, as you know.<br>用不着告诉他怎样做，你知道，他有自己的主意。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take sb/sth to the ˈmat (AmE, informal)</b></td><td>与…激烈争辩；与…较量到底</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>The union is ready to take management to the mat over overtime pay.<br>工会准备为加班费和资方斗到底。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>lay, put, roll, etc. out the welcome ˈmat</b></td><td>热情欢迎；隆重接待</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The village rolled out the welcome mat for the returning soldiers.<br>村里张灯结彩，热情迎接归来的士兵。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be no ˈmatch for sb/sth</b></td><td>不是…的对手；比不上</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Our little team was no match for the champions last Saturday.<br>上周六我们这支小队根本不是冠军队的对手。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>find/meet your ˈmatch (in sb)</b></td><td>遇到旗鼓相当的对手</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He thought he could beat anyone, but he's his match.<br>他以为自己天下无敌。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>as a matter of ˈcourse</b></td><td>作为常规；理所当然地</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The hotel changes the towels daily as a matter of course.<br>酒店照例每天更换毛巾。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>as a matter of ˈfact (spoken)</b></td><td>事实上；其实</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>As a matter of fact, today happens to be my fortieth birthday.<br>事实上，今天正好是我四十岁生日。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(do sth) as a matter of ˈform</b></td><td>作为例行公事</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>They asked for my ID as a matter of form, then waved me through.<br>他们例行公事查了我的证件，就放我过去了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be another/a different ˈmatter</b></td><td>是另一回事；另当别论</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Reading Chinese is fine; speaking it fluently is another matter entirely.<br>读中文没问题，但流利地说完全是另一回事。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be the ˈmatter (with sb/sth)</b></td><td>（某人或某物）出了问题</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>You look pale—what's the matter with you this morning?<br>你脸色发白，今天早上怎么了？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be a matter of oˈpinion</b></td><td>见仁见智；看法因人而异</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Whether the film is a masterpiece is very much a matter of opinion.<br>这部电影算不算杰作，实在见仁见智。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the ˈfact/ˈtruth of the matter</b></td><td>事实真相；实情是</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The truth of the matter is that nobody checked the figures.<br>事实真相是，根本没人核对过数字。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>for ˈthat matter (spoken)</b></td><td>就此而言；其实也一样</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I've never been to Paris, or to France for that matter.<br>我没去过巴黎，其实整个法国都没去过。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a matter of ˈdays, ˈmiles, ˈpounds, etc.</b></td><td>只有几天（或几英里、几镑等）</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The nearest hospital is a matter of miles away, luckily for us.<br>最近的医院不过几英里，我们算走运。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>no matter who, what, where, when, etc.</b></td><td>无论谁（或什么、何处、何时）</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>No matter what she says, don't lend him money again.<br>不管她怎么说，都别再借钱给他。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take matters into your own ˈhands</b></td><td>自己动手解决；自行处理</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The police were doing nothing about finding my car, so I decided to take matters into my own hands and look for it myself.<br>警方根本没有寻找我丢失的汽车，我决定自己去找。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>to the ˈmax</b></td><td>最大限度地；到极点</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She believes in livng life to the max.<br>她认为应该尽情享受人生。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be that as it ˈmay • that's</b></td><td>尽管如此；即便这样</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>I know he's tried hard; be that as it may, his work is just not good enough.<br>我知道他已经尽力了，尽管如此，他的工</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mea ˈculpa (from Latin, often humorous)</b></td><td>是我的错；我认错</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>Mea culpa—I booked the tickets for the wrong weekend entirely.<br>是我的错，我把票订到了另一个周末。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈmeal of/out of sth (informal)</b></td><td>小题大做；把事情弄得过于复杂</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Just write her a short note - don't make a meal of it.<br>给她写个便条就行了，不要小题大做。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈmeal ticket (informal)</b></td><td>饭票；供养自己的人或物</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He suspected that he was just a meal ticket for her.<br>他怀疑自己只是她的一张饭票而已。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be no mean... (approving)</b></td><td>是很了不起的…；相当出色的…</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>His mother was a painter and he's no mean artust himself.<br>他母亲是位画家，他自己也是一位不俗的艺术象。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be/mean ˈnothing to sb</b></td><td>对某人不重要；某人毫不在意</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Why should he go to the funeral? The dead man was nothing to him.<br>他为什么要去参加葬礼？死者又不是他什么人。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the happy/golden ˈmean (approving)</b></td><td>中庸之道；折中之道</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>Between strict dieting and eating whatever, she found the golden mean.<br>在严格节食和放开吃之间，她找到了中庸之道。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mean ˈbusiness (informal)</b></td><td>是认真的；说到做到</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>When the landlord changed the locks, we knew he meant business.<br>房东把锁换了，我们就知道他是来真的。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>mean to ˈsay</b></td><td>（强调）我是说；难道说</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Do you mean to say you walked home twelve miles in the rain?<br>你是说你冒雨走了十二英里回家？（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get sb's ˈmeaning (informal)</b></td><td>领会某人的意思</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I get your meaning. You don't need to say any more.<br>我明白了，你不用再多说了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>not know the meaning of the ˈword</b></td><td>根本不懂…；完全不知何为…</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>My brother works weekends—he doesn't know the meaning of the word rest.<br>我哥连周末都干活，他根本不懂什么叫休息。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>by ˈall means (spoken)</b></td><td>当然可以；请便</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>By all means borrow the car, just fill the tank before you return it.<br>车尽管借去开，还的时候把油加满就行。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>by ˈno (manner of) means • not by ˈany</b></td><td>绝不；一点也不</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The deal is by no means settled, so don't celebrate yet.<br>这笔交易远未敲定，先别庆祝。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be meant to be sth</b></td><td>据说是；本应是</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>That new ramen place is meant to be the best in the city.<br>那家新开的拉面店据说是全城最好的。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈmeantime/ˈmeanwhile</b></td><td>在此期间；与此同时</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The doctor sees you at four; in the meantime, grab a coffee downstairs.<br>医生四点见你，这期间你先去楼下喝杯咖啡。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get/have/take the ˈmeasure of sb • get/</b></td><td>摸清某人的底细；掂出某人的分量</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>After two meetings she had the measure of her new boss completely.<br>开了两次会，她就把新上司摸透了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have/take sb's ˈmeasure (formal)</b></td><td>看透某人；估量某人的能力</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>The champion soon had the measure of his young opponent.<br>冠军很快就摸清了年轻对手的实力。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in great, large, etc. ˈmeasure (formal)</b></td><td>在很大程度上</td><td>★★<br>★</td><td>His success is in great measure the result of good luck.<br>他的成功在很大程度上要归因于运气。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in some, equal, etc. ˈmeasure (formal)</b></td><td>在某种（或同等）程度上</td><td>★★<br>★</td><td>The introduction of a new tax accounted in some measure for the downfall of the government.<br>这届政府的垮台在某种程度上归因于新税的征收。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make sth to ˈmeasure (BrE)</b></td><td>定做；量身定制</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>All his shirts are made to measure.<br>都是量身定做的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be meat and ˈdrink (to sb)</b></td><td>是某人的一大乐事；正合某人胃口</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Stories about the royal family are meat and drink to journalists.<br>有关王室的传闻最受记者欢迎。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>give sb a taste/dose of their own ˈmedicine</b></td><td>以其人之道还治其人之身</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Give her a dose of her own medicine and make her wait for you. Then maybe she won't be so slow next time.<br>你让她也尝尝等人的滋味，也许下次她就不会那么慢吞吞的了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take your ˈmedicine (like a ˈman) (usually humorous)</b></td><td>甘愿受罚；忍受不快</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He really hates shopping, but he goes anyway and takes his medicine like a man.<br>他非常讨厌购物，但他还是毫无怨言地去了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>meet the/your ˈeye(s)</b></td><td>映入眼帘；呈现在眼前</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>A sea of broken glass met our eyes when we opened the door.<br>门一开，满地碎玻璃映入眼帘。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>meet sb's ˈeyes (also meet sb's ˈgaze, ˈlook, etc.)</b></td><td>与某人目光相遇；直视某人</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She was afraid to meet my eyes because she knew what I was thinking.<br>她不敢正眼看我，因为她知道我正在想什么。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>meet sb halfˈway</b></td><td>与某人妥协；各让一步</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I can't agree to all your suggestions, but I am prepared to meet you halfway.<br>我不能同意你所有的条件，但是我可以作出某些让步。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>meet your ˈMaker (especially humorous)</b></td><td>去见上帝；死</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The car was out of control. There was nothing I could do except prepare to meet my maker!<br>汽车失控了，我完全无能为力，只能准备去见上帝!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌmeet your Waterˈloo</b></td><td>遭遇滑铁卢；一败涂地</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>She can usually beat anyone at chess, but I think with Kathy she's met her Waterloo.<br>她下国际象棋一般没有什么对手，但我想最终凯西会击败她。 ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌmelt in your ˈmouth</b></td><td>（食物）入口即化</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>They serve steaks that just melt in your mouth.<br>他们做的牛排柔嫩可口。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈmelting pot (especially BrE)</b></td><td>处于变化之中；尚未定型</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>The team's plans for next season are still in the melting pot.<br>球队下赛季的计划仍在变动之中。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>if ˌmemory ˈserves</b></td><td>如果我没记错的话</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>If memory serves, we last met at that awful conference in Leeds.<br>如果我没记错，我们上次见面是在利兹那场糟糕的会议上。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>in/out of the ˈpicture (informal)</b></td><td>参与其中；置身局外</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Morris is likely to win, with Jones out of the picture now.<br>现在琼斯退出，莫里斯很有可能获胜。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>put/keep sb in the ˈpicture (informal)</b></td><td>向某人介绍情况；让某人了解进展</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Before you start work, let me put you in the picture about the way the office is run.<br>在你开始工作之前，让我介绍一下办公室的运作方式。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pie in the ˈsky (informal)</b></td><td>空中楼阁；不切实际的空想</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Most voters know that the big promises which polittcians make before an election are just pie in the sky.<br>大部分选民都知道政客们在选举前的美妙许诺都是空头支票。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>give sb a piece of your ˈmind (informal)</b></td><td>直言斥责；把某人痛骂一顿</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>If he doesn't turn that music down soon, I'm going to give him a piece of my mind.<br>如果他不快点把音乐关小，我就要说说他了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(all) in one ˈpiece (informal)</b></td><td>安然无恙；完好无损</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The bike is scratched, but at least you got home in one piece.<br>自行车刮花了，好在你人平安到家。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(all) of a ˈpiece (with sth) (formal)</b></td><td>与…一致；与…如出一辙</td><td>★<br>★</td><td>When you see a lot of his paintings together, you feel that his work is all of a piece.<br>如果你同时看到许多他的画作，就会觉得风格很一致。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>piece by ˈpiece</b></td><td>一点一点地；逐件地</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He took his motorcycle apart piece by piece, cleaned it, and put it back together.<br>他一点一点地把摩托车拆开，擦洗干净，然后又重新组装好。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a piece of ˈcake (informal) (BrE also a piece of ˈpiss△, slang)</b></td><td>小菜一碟；轻而易举的事</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>After climbing mountains in the Swiss Alps, going up English hills is a piece of cake.<br>攀登过了瑞士的阿尔卑斯山后，爬英国的小山简直是小菜一碟。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>your/the ˌpièce de réˈsistance (from French)</b></td><td>最精彩的作品；压轴之作</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>I hope you all enjoyed your main course. And now for my piece de resistance: chocolate gateau!<br>我希望大家都喜欢刚才享用的主菜，现在是我的拿手作品:巧克力奶油蛋糕!</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>fall to ˈpieces</b></td><td>破旧不堪；散架；垮掉</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Our car is falling to pieces, we've had it so long.<br>我们的汽车买的时间太长，已经快散架了。 2 (</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>go (all) to ˈpieces (informal)</b></td><td>崩溃；垮掉；沮丧至极</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She went to pieces when she heard the news about her brother.<br>听到她弟弟的消息，她整个人垮了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in a pig's ˈeye (AmE, informal)</b></td><td>才不是呢；绝无可能</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>He told you father owns the company? In a pig's eye!<br>他告诉你这家公司是他父亲的？这简直是弥天大谎。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈpig of yourself (informal)</b></td><td>大吃大喝；吃相难看</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She always makes such a pig of herself.<br>她总是胡吃海喝。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a pig's ˈear (out) of sth (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>把事情办砸；弄得一团糟</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He made a pig's ear of painting the door and had to start again.<br>他把门刷得一塌糊涂，只好重来。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(buy) a pig in a ˈpoke</b></td><td>隔山买牛；盲目购买</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Make sure you take the car for a proper test drive - you don't want to buy a pig in a poke, do you?<br>这车你一定要好好试开一下，可别隔山买牛。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>be sb's ˈpigeon (old-fashioned, BrE)</b></td><td>是某人的分内事；由某人负责</td><td>★<br>★★★</td><td>Somebody needs to write a report on training for the manager, but it's not my pigeon.<br>得有人给经理写一份关于培训的报告，不过这不是我的事。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pigs might ˈfly (BrE) (AmE when ˌpigs ˈfly)</b></td><td>太阳打西边出来；绝无可能</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>He'll tidy his room on time? Yes, and pigs might fly.<br>他会按时收拾房间？太阳打西边出来吧。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>come down the ˈpike (AmE, informal)</b></td><td>出现；发生</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>We're hearing a lot about new inventions coming down the pike.<br>我们不断听说有新发明问世。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a/your ˈpile (informal)</b></td><td>赚一大笔钱；发财</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He made his pile in shipping and retired at forty-five.<br>他做航运发了财，四十五岁就退休了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pile on the ˈagony/ˈgloom (informal, especially BrE)</b></td><td>大肆渲染痛苦；添油加醋博同情</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He always piles on the agony when he has a cold; you'd think he was dying.<br>他感冒时总是夸大其词，你会以为他快死了。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be on the ˈpill</b></td><td>服用口服避孕药</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She's been on the pill since she was at university.<br>她从大学时起就一直在服避孕药。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>sugar/sweeten the ˈpill</b></td><td>使不愉快的事较易接受；给苦药裹糖衣</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He tried to sweeten the pill by telling her she'd only be in hospital a few days.<br>他想把事情说得和缓一些， 就对她说她只须住几天院。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be driven, pushed, etc. from ˌpillar to ˈpost</b></td><td>被迫四处奔走；到处碰壁</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>Vast numbers of refugees have been pushed from pillar to post in that area.<br>大批的难民被迫在那个地区到处奔波。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a pillar of soˈciety, etc.</b></td><td>社会中坚；栋梁人物</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The old doctor was regarded as a pillar of society in this town.<br>这位老医生被视为镇上的中坚人物。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈpillar of soˈciety/the comˈmunity</b></td><td>社会栋梁；中流砥柱</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Person couldn't believe that a pillar of the community him had been caught stealing from his employer.<br>我难以相信像他这样的社区重要人物竟然因偷雇主的东西而被抓。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈpillow talk (informal)</b></td><td>枕边私房话；枕边悄悄话</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He admitted he had leaked the company secret during pillow talk with his girlfriend.<br>他承认自己在和女友说枕边话时泄露了公司机密。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pin your ˈfaith/ˈhopes on sb/sth</b></td><td>寄希望于；指望</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He's pinning his faith on the revival of the economy.<br>他寄希望于经济复苏。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>at a ˈpinch/ˈpush (BrE) (AmE in a ˈpinch)</b></td><td>必要时；不得已时</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>This sofa sleeps two people comfortably, and three at a pinch.<br>这张沙发睡两个人很舒服，挤一挤三个人也行。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pinch ˈpennies (informal)</b></td><td>省吃俭用；一分钱掰两半花</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>We've been pinching pennies all year so that we can visit my relatives in Australia in December.<br>我们精打细算省了一年，以便能在 12月去澳大利亚探亲。•'</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈpenny-pinching noun • ˈpenny-pincher noun</b></td><td>小气；吝啬鬼</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>His penny-pinching finally paid off when he bought the flat with cash.<br>他的精打细算终于有了回报，他全款买下了那套公寓。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take sth with a pinch of ˈsalt (informal)</b></td><td>不完全相信；半信半疑</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She told me she knew people in the move industry, but 1 took that with a pinch of salt.<br>她跟我说她认识电影界的人，不过我对此半信半疑。01</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈpink (old-fashioned, informal)</b></td><td>非常健康；满面红光</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>Here are some tips to keep you in the pink.<br>这里有几条能让你容光焕发的小贴士。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>see pink ˈelephants (informal)</b></td><td>（因醉酒等）看到幻象</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>One more whisky and you'll be seeing pink elephants, my friend.<br>朋友，再来一杯威士忌你就要出现幻觉了。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on your ˈpins (old-fashioned, informal)</b></td><td>靠自己的腿站立（或行走）</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>He's not as steady on his pins as he used to be. I worry about him going out.<br>他的腿脚不如以前那么稳健了，他出门我会担心。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pip sb at/to the ˈpost (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>以微弱优势险胜；最后关头击败</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>We thought wea won the contract, but we were pipped at the post by a rival company.<br>我们以为能贏得合约， 可是在最后一刻输给了一家对手公司。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˈpipe dream</b></td><td>白日梦；幻想</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She's got this never pipe dream about being a pop star.<br>她幻想着成为流行歌星。 ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>put ˈthat in your pipe and smoke it (informal)</b></td><td>不管爱不爱听你都得接受</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>I'm not giving you any more money to spend on that car. So put that in your pipe and smoke it!<br>我不会再给你钱让你花在那辆车上了， 不管你喜欢不喜欢就这样了!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the ˈpipeline</b></td><td>在酝酿中；在筹备中</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>We have an interesting new database program in the pipeline. It should be on sale early next year.<br>我们正在设计一个有趣的新数据库程序，明年年初大概就能上市了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pique sb's ˈinterest, curiˈosity, etc. (especially AmE)</b></td><td>引起某人的兴趣（或好奇）</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The Programme piqued public interest in this rare bird.<br>这个节目毫无疑问激起了公众对这种稀有鸟类的兴趣。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be on the ˈpiss (BrE, △, slang)</b></td><td>（在酒吧等）狂饮；豪饮</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>The whole team was on the piss all weekend after winning the cup.<br>夺冠之后，全队整个周末都在拼命喝酒。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>piss yourself (laughing) (BrE, △, slang)</b></td><td>笑得不能自制；笑破肚皮</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>Poor Kath - she was lying on the floor and we were all pissing ourselves laughing!<br>可怜的凯丝，她躺在地上，我们一个个都笑得直不起腰来!</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take the ˈpiss (out of sb/sth) (BrE, △, slang)</b></td><td>取笑；拿…寻开心</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>He told me he thought I had a fantastic singing voice, but I think he was taking the piss (= he was only joking).<br>他说我有一副美妙的歌喉，不过我觉得他只是在拿我开心。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) pissed as a ˈnewt (BrE, △, slang)</b></td><td>烂醉如泥；酩酊大醉</td><td>★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>By midnight he was as pissed as a newt and singing on the table.<br>到了午夜他已经烂醉如泥，还站在桌上唱歌。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈpit stop (informal, especially AmE)</b></td><td>（旅途中）短暂停留；歇脚</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I'm getting a bit hungry. Shall we make a pit stop at the next service station?<br>我有点饿了，我们在下一个服务站停一下好吗？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>the pit of your/the ˈstomach</b></td><td>心窝；心底</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He had a sudden sinking feeling in the pit of his stomach.<br>他内心深处突然有一种沮丧的感觉。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pit your ˈwits (against sb/sth)</b></td><td>（与…）斗智</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>He's pitting his wits against the computer chess game.<br>他正与计算机下棋斗智。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>make a ˈpitch for sb/sth • make a ˈpitch to do sth</b></td><td>极力争取；竭力游说</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Both presidential candidates have promised to make a pitch for better roads and schools.<br>两位总统候选人都许诺一定会努力改善交通和教育。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>pitch a ˈline/ˈstory/ˈyarn (to sb) (informal)</b></td><td>（向某人）编瞎话；找借口</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>He assured me that it really happened, but I reckon he was just pitching me a line.<br>他言之凿凿地说确有其事，可是我觉得他在说谎。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌpitched ˈbattle</b></td><td>激战；大规模冲突</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>There was a pitched battle earlier today between police and demonstrators. Two hundred people were injured, ten seriously.<br>今天早些时候警察和示威者发生了混战，两百人受伤，其中十人伤势严重。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be the ˈpits (informal)</b></td><td>糟透了；差到极点</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>The teaching at this school is the pits.<br>这所学校的教学实在差劲。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˌmore's the ˈpity (BrE, informal)</b></td><td>很遗憾；不幸的是</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He can't read and he doesn't want to learn, more's the pity.<br>不幸的是，他不认字也不想学。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>all ˈover the place (informal)</b></td><td>到处都是；乱七八糟</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>In my job I have to travel all over the place.<br>我的工作需要到处出差。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(not) be sb's ˈplace to do sth</b></td><td>（不）是某人分内的事</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>It's not my place to tell your parents what you did last night.<br>你昨晚干了什么，轮不到我去告诉你父母。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>fall, drop, etc. into ˈplace</b></td><td>（因新信息而）变得清楚明朗</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>When I found out that he was Lucy's uncle, everything fell into place.<br>当我发现他是露西的舅舅时， 一切都顺理成章了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>give ˈplace to sb/sth (formal)</b></td><td>让位于；被…取代</td><td>★★<br>★</td><td>Houses and factories gave place to open fields as the train gathered speed.<br>火车逐渐加速，驶过了房屋和厂房，进入旷野。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>if ˌI was/were in ˈyour place</b></td><td>如果我是你；换了我的话</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>If I were in your place, I'd take the job and move to Berlin.<br>如果我是你，我会接下这份工作，搬去柏林。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in ˈmy, ˈyour, etc. place</b></td><td>处在我（或你等）的境况</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>I wouldn't like to be in your place.<br>我可不想处于你的境地。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in ˈplace</b></td><td>准备就绪；安排妥当</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Everything seems to be in place for a successful peace conference.<br>看来进行成功和谈的一切都准备好了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in place of sb/sth • in sb's/sth's ˈplace</b></td><td>代替；顶替</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>You can use milk in place of cream in this recipe.<br>这个食谱中牛奶可以用奶油代替。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>out of ˈplace</b></td><td>位置不当；不合时宜；格格不入</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Some of these files seem to be out of place.<br>有些档案似乎没放对地方。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a place in the ˈsun</b></td><td>有发展前途的地位；出头之日</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>After years of small roles, she finally found her place in the sun.<br>演了多年小角色后，她终于熬出了头。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>put sb in their ˈplace</b></td><td>灭某人威风；让某人识相</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>That young man needs putting in his place. He behaves as if he were the manager here.<br>应该让那个年轻人明白自己几斤几两，他的一举一动就好像他是这里的经理。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take ˈplace</b></td><td>发生；举行</td><td>★★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The wedding will take place in a small church outside town.<br>婚礼将在城外一座小教堂举行。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take sb's ˈplace • take the place of sb</b></td><td>代替；接替</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Miss Jones has left the school and this term her place has been taken by Mr Carter.<br>琼斯小姐离校了，这学期她的工作已由卡特先生顶替。〇</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take your ˈplace</b></td><td>就位；入座</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>We all took our places round the table.<br>我们都围着桌子入座。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be well, ideally, better, etc. ˈplaced (for sth/to do sth)</b></td><td>处于有利地位；有良好条件</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>With her contacts, she's ideally placed to launch the new campaign.<br>凭她的人脉，她最适合来发起这场新活动。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>change/swap ˈplaces (with sb)</b></td><td>交换位置；互换处境</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The Smiths can afford to 80 away a lot because they haven't got a family to bring up. But I wouldn't want to change places with them.<br>史密斯家有钱经常出去，因为他们没有孩子要养，不过我可不想跟他们换。</td></tr>

Plus ga change...<br>尽管今年的比赛号称欢迎新人新想法，可是没有位新手进入决赛，变来变去还是老样子</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>if/when it ˌcomes to the ˈpoint</b></td><td>到了必须作决定的时候</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I'm not frightened of flying, but when it comes to the point rd rather travel by train.<br>我不害怕坐飞机，可是事到临头我还是情愿坐火车。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>a point of deˈparture</b></td><td>出发点；（讨论的）起点</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>Professor Brown's recent article will certainly be the point of departure for future research on the subject.<br>布朗教授近期的论文肯定会是今后对此课题继续研究的起点。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a ˌpoint of ˈhonour (BrE) (AmE a ˌpoint of ˈhonor)</b></td><td>事关名节的事；关乎荣誉之举</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>It was a point of honour for him to pay back every penny he owed.<br>把欠的每一分钱都还清，对他来说是事关名节的事。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>point the ˈway (to/towards sth)</b></td><td>指明方向；预示发展趋势</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>New high-speed trains are pointing the way to a new age of European travel.<br>新的高速火车引领了欧洲旅行的新时代。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>to the ˈpoint</b></td><td>中肯；切题</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The speech was short and to the point.<br>这个讲话简短扼要。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>to the ˈpoint of sth/of doing sth</b></td><td>达到…的程度；近乎</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The restaurant staff were unhelpful to the point of rudeness.<br>餐馆的服务员一点也不主动热情，简直到了无礼的地步。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>be/go on the ˈrampage</b></td><td>横冲直撞；到处撒野搞破坏</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>After their team lost, some of the crowd went on the rampage through the town.<br>看到他们支持的球队输了比赛，一些人跑到镇上横冲直撞，寻衅滋事。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>close ˈranks</b></td><td>（对外）团结一致；结成一气</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The department closed ranks and refused to say anything to the waiting reporters.<br>该部门上下一心，拒绝对守候的记者透露任何情况。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>hold sb to ˈransom</b></td><td>绑架某人索取赎金；要挟</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The kidnappers held the little girl to ransom for more than eight hours.<br>绑韭绑架了那个小女孩八个多小时，以案要赎金。 2</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>a ˌrap over the ˈknuckles (informal)</b></td><td>批评；训斥</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He got a rap over the knuckles for spending too much money on his business lunches.<br>因为在商务午餐上花钱太多，他挨了一顿批评。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take the ˈrap (for sb/sth) (informal)</b></td><td>（为他人）受罚；背黑锅</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She was prepared to take the rap for the broken window, even though it was her brother who had kicked the ball.<br>她甘愿为打破窗户受罚，尽管那球是她弟弟踢的。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>a ˌred-ˈletter day</b></td><td>值得纪念的日子；有特殊意义的一天</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Today was a red-letter day. We heard we had won a free trip tojapan.<br>今天真是个值得纪念的好日子。我们听说我们赢得了免费去日本度假的机会。 ②</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>redress the ˈbalance</b></td><td>恢复平衡；重新做到公平合理</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>They have won the last two games, so today well be trying to redress the balance.<br>他们已经赢了前两场比赛， 所以今天我们要竭力拉平与他们的差距。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reˌduced ˈcircumstances</b></td><td>境况拮据；家道中落</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>The old actress lived out her final years in reduced circumstances near Brighton.<br>这位老演员晚年在布莱顿附近过着拮据的生活。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>live in reˌduced ˈcircumstances</b></td><td>生活拮据；穷困潦倒</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>As time passed, his reduced circumstances became more and more obvious to his friends and colleagues.<br>随着时间的流逝，他的朋友和同事都越发了解到他捉襟见肘的困境。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in/with ˈreference to (formal or written)</b></td><td>关于；就…而言</td><td>★★★★<br>★</td><td>With reference to your letter of July 22..<br>关于你7月22日的来信⋯</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reflect well, badly, etc. on sb/sth</b></td><td>使显得好（或坏）；给人某种印象</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>This incident reflects badly on everyone involved.<br>这一事件使所有相关人员给人们留下了极坏的印象。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>bathe/bask in reflected ˈglory</b></td><td>沾光；仰仗他人的荣耀</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>She wasn't happy to bathe in the reflected glory of her daughter's success, as she wanted to succeed on her own.<br>她不满足于靠女儿的成功而出名，她想拥有自己的成功。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>a sad, poor, etc. reflection on sth</b></td><td>有损…名誉的事；反映出…的不足</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The increase in crime is a sad reflection on our society today.<br>犯罪的增加悲哀地反映出当今社会的弊端。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>on mature reˈflection/consideˈration</b></td><td>经过深思熟虑之后</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>On mature reflection, I've decided not to accept the job in Berlin.<br>经过慎重考虑，我决定不接受柏林那份工作。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reˌfresh sb's/your ˈmemory</b></td><td>唤起记忆；帮助想起</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Refresh my memory, will you? How many children has he Before I got?<br>帮我想想好吗？他有几个孩子？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>have reˈgard to sth (law)</b></td><td>考虑到；顾及</td><td>★★<br>☆</td><td>It is always necessary to have regard to the terms of the contract.<br>仔细考虑合同条款总是很有必要的。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in/with reˈgard to sb/sth (formal)</b></td><td>关于；对于</td><td>★★★★<br>★★</td><td>With regard to your complaint, we have already contacted the delivery company.<br>关于您的投诉，我们已联系了配送公司。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in this/that reˈgard (formal)</b></td><td>在这一点上；与此相关</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>I have nothing further to say in this regard.<br>关于这一点，我没什么要补充的了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>as regards sb/sth (formal)</b></td><td>关于；至于</td><td>★★★<br>★</td><td>As about Or regards the method of payment, a decision will be made after the contract has been signed.<br>至于付款方式，会在合同签订以后再作决定。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in the region of</b></td><td>大约；…左右</td><td>★★★★<br>★★</td><td>Repairing the roof will cost somewhere in the region of five thousand pounds.<br>修屋顶大概要花五千英镑左右。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) regular as ˈclockwork</b></td><td>极有规律；准时可靠</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>She arrives at work on her bicycle at 8.45 every day, as regular as clockwork.<br>她每天骑自行车上班， 总是在8:45准时到达。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>give/allow free/full ˈrein to sb/sth</b></td><td>对…放任自由；任其发挥</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>In a novel the author need not Keep to the facts, but a textbook is not the place to give free rein to your imagination.<br>小说作者不用拘泥于事实，而课本却不允许凭空想象。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reinvent the ˈwheel</b></td><td>重复劳动做无用功；重新发明轮子</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>There's no point in us reinventing the wheel. Why can't we just leave things as they are?<br>我们根本没有必要进行无谓的重复，为什么不维持现状呢？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ˈrelatively speaking</b></td><td>相对来说；比较而言</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.<br>相比而言，这些工作的报酬都不差。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>get reˈligion (informal, often disapproving)</b></td><td>突然变得虔诚；皈依宗教</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>He got religion while he was touring in Australia.<br>他在澳大利亚旅游时突然开始信教了。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>something to reˈmember sb by (informal)</b></td><td>给点厉害瞧瞧；惩罚（尤指体罚）</td><td>★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The bouncer gave him something to remember him by outside the club.<br>保安在夜店门口给了他点厉害瞧瞧。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be reˈmembered as/for sth</b></td><td>因…而被人铭记；因…出名</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>He is best remembered as the man who brought jaza to Britain.<br>他因为把爵士乐带到英国而为人们所熟知。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be far/further/furthest reˈmoved from sth</b></td><td>与…大相径庭；与…毫不相干</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>Many of these books are far removed from the reality of the children's lives.<br>这些书很多都远远脱离了孩子们的现实生活。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>reopen old ˈwounds</b></td><td>揭旧疮疤；重提伤心事</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>L0ok let's try not to reopen any old wounds this time, OK?<br>嘿，咱们这次别提任何伤心事，好吗？</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>beyond reˈpair</b></td><td>无法修复；破损不堪</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The engine was damaged beyond repair.<br>引擎已经遭到严重损坏，无法修复。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in good, bad, etc. reˈpair (also in a good, bad, etc. state of reˈpair) (formal)</b></td><td>状况良好（或不佳等）；保养得如何</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The house is in a terrible state of repair.<br>这所房子状况极糟。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in reˈserve</b></td><td>备用；储备着</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The money was being kept in reserve for their retirement.<br>这笔钱是存着等他们</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in ˈresidence</b></td><td>驻留的；（在大学等）有正式职位的</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>The flag shows that the Queen is in residence at the castle today.<br>旗帜表明女王今天正驻跸城堡。（自拟）</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>in reˈspect of sth (formal)</b></td><td>关于；就…而言</td><td>★★★<br>★</td><td>Large now be expected in respect of fuel prices.<br>至于燃料价格，可能会有大幅增长。 2</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>with respect to sth (formal)</b></td><td>关于；至于</td><td>★★★★<br>★</td><td>With respect to your enquiry about the new pension scheme, I have pleasure in enclosing our leaflet.<br>关于您对新的养老金计划的询问，我有幸</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>be no respecter of ˈpersons</b></td><td>一视同仁；不分高低贵贱</td><td>★★<br>★★</td><td>Though still young,she was a very confident girl. She was no respecter of persons and never thought before she spoke.<br>她虽然还很年轻，却是一个很自信的女孩。她对大家视同仁，而且总是直言不讳。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>at ˈrest</b></td><td>静止不动；安息</td><td>★★★<br>★★</td><td>At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.<br>一动不动时，这种昆虫看上去像一片枯叶。 2</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>come to ˈrest</b></td><td>停下来；不再移动</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>The car crashed through the barrier and came to rest in a field.<br>汽车撞倒栅栏，停在农田里。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>for the ˈrest (BrE, formal)</b></td><td>至于其他；除此之外</td><td>★★<br>★</td><td>The most important thing in life is to do your duty. For the rest I care nothing.<br>生活中最重要的是要履行自己的职责， 除此之外我什么都不在乎。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>ˌrest on your ˈlaurels (usually disapproving)</b></td><td>吃老本；躺在功劳簿上不思进取</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I know you got a very good degree from Oxford but what are you going to do with your life now? You can't rest on your laurels for ever, you know.<br>我知道你在牛津得了个好学位，可是你对现在的生活又有什么打算呢？要知道，你不可能一辈子吃老本。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>have a hide/skin like a rhiˈnoceros (informal)</b></td><td>脸皮极厚；不怕别人批评</td><td>★<br>★★★★</td><td>You need a skin like a rhinoceros to survive in this newsroom.<br>在这个新闻编辑室待下去，你得脸皮厚得像犀牛皮。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>cut, tear, etc. sth to ˈribbons</b></td><td>把…撕成碎片；驳得体无完肤</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>She was so furious when she discovered her husband with another woman that she cut all his clothes to ribbons.<br>发现丈夫和别的女人有染，她气得把他所有的衣服都撕成碎片。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>(as) rich as ˈCroesus (informal)</b></td><td>极其富有；富可敌国</td><td>★★<br>★★★</td><td>His uncle is as rich as Croesus but still drives a rusty van.<br>他叔叔富得流油，却还开着辆生锈的货车。（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>be ˈrid of sb/sth (formal)</b></td><td>摆脱；除掉</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>I was glad to be rid of the car when I finally sold it.<br>我很高兴终于脱手把车卖掉了。(</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>good ˈriddance (to sb/sth)</b></td><td>总算摆脱了；谢天谢地走了</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>The noisy tenants upstairs have moved out at last — good riddance!<br>楼上吵闹的租客终于搬走了，真是谢天谢地！（自拟）</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>have/give sb a rough/an easy ˈride (informal)</b></td><td>（使）日子难过；（使）一帆风顺</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>She hasn't always had an easy ride in her business life.<br>在生意上，她并非一直一帆风顺。</td></tr>

<tr><td><b>ride ˈshotgun (AmE, informal)</b></td><td>坐在副驾驶座上</td><td>★★★<br>★★★★★</td><td>My turn to ride shotgun today!<br>今天轮到我坐前排了! ⑦</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>ride a/the ˈwave of sth</b></td><td>趁…之势；受益于某种潮流</td><td>★★★<br>★★★</td><td>Schools are riding a wave of renewed public interest.<br>各个学校都因公众的再次关注而受益。</td></tr>
<tr><td><b>take sb for a ˈride (informal)</b></td><td>欺骗；愚弄（某人）</td><td>★★★★<br>★★★★</td><td>That mechanic took us for a ride and charged for parts he never fitted.<br>那修车师傅骗了我们，收了根本没装的零件钱。（自拟）</td></tr>

They don't agree with the new terms and conditions, but if they go on strike they may lose their jobs altogether.<br>工人们感觉现在陷入了进退两难的境地。他们不同意新的条款，可要是继续罢工，有可能大家都会失业。</td></tr>
